question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **IRREPRESSIBLE**
solution: The correct answer is: **Uncontrollable**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Irrepressible"** means something or someone that cannot be controlled or restrained; it refers to an overwhelming energy or feeling that is impossible to suppress. (अवश्यम्भावी / अचिरनीय) • **Example:** Her irrepressible laughter filled the room with joy. • **"Uncontrollable"** refers to something that cannot be managed, restrained, or regulated. It is often used to describe emotions, behaviors, or forces that are beyond one's control. (अवश्यम्भावी / असंयमित) • **Example:** The child's uncontrollable excitement made it difficult for him to sit still. • Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'Irrepressible'** is **'Uncontrollable'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Uncontrollable**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Forgettable** (भूलने योग्य): Something that is easily forgotten or not worth remembering. • **Example:** The movie was so dull and forgettable that I couldn't recall its plot the next day. • **Unbearable** (असहनीय): Something that cannot be endured or tolerated. • **Example:** The unbearable heat of the desert made it impossible to continue the journey. • **Avoidable** (टाला जा सकने वाला): Something that can be prevented or evaded. • **Example:** Many traffic accidents are avoidable if drivers follow the rules. 35:T934, The correct answer is: **Unscented**.
